payload.notes:
SecureSH 0.1.16 — major RDP, streaming, files, and UI update.

RDP
- Fixed the crash connecting to Windows ("NoneType has no attribute value").
- Crisp text: the remote desktop now renders at physical pixels.
- Clipboard both ways: text and files (local <-> remote) over the RDP clipboard.
- Keyboard: Alt+Tab / Win / Ctrl+Alt+Del redirect to the remote; on-screen key palette + Reset-keys; no more stuck modifiers or a stuck "+" cursor.
- Remote resolution selector in the control bar; the bar collapses so it never blocks remote window buttons.
- Clear disconnect reason on the pane; the canvas blanks on disconnect instead of showing a frozen frame.

Remote Desktop / streaming
- Capture secondary monitors instead of a black frame; live monitor switching on every path.
- Higher-res capture; the view fills the pane and re-fits when the resolution changes.

Files (SFTP)
- Total Commander-style dual-pane file manager; rename / delete / mkdir, right-click menu, and an in-app editor.

UI
- Split panes can hold different session types, each starting from an empty chooser (no more cloning the same session).
- Drag to reorder sidebar sessions and tabs, and drag sessions in and out of groups.
- Reconnect button on disconnected panes; Disconnect keeps the pane instead of closing the tab.
- Tab bar and session toolbar split onto separate rows; fixed session-row buttons overlapping the host name; modals show a single close button.

Desktop
- System tray with close-to-tray and Windows autostart.
- Auto-detects and installs the WebView2 Runtime on startup.

Security
- The session inventory is now locked behind the master password (cancelling the unlock no longer exposes sessions).

Updates
- The frozen build bundles a CA trust store so the self-updater can verify TLS.
